items.title: Josef Balcerak Interview, 1968-05-17
items.q: American music was prohibited in Germany during Hitler, especially jazz

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Did, how long did this last that you could listen to jazz? Was it interrupted? Stopped?

Of course, not, uh, exactly, uh, interest, but no possibility to hear except military music. As you can imagine, it is not the same.
